headline: African Development Bank Launches 2026-2030 Water Facility Strategy in Cairo
summary: The African Development Bank Group unveiled its 2026-2030 African Water Facility Strategy at Cairo Water Week, calling on African states and private investors to scale financing for water and sanitation infrastructure.
why: Multilateral development bank strategies channel billions of dollars into climate adaptation and essential utility infrastructure across African economies.

impacts.name: African Water Infrastructure
impacts.why: The five-year strategy mobilizes public and private capital for continental utility construction.
